use_FacingInterpreter_call: call the FacingInterpreter class to interpret yaw, pitch, or location facing directions for a robot agent
parse_number_from_span: parse a numeric degree value from a text span using the number_from_span function
interpret_absolute_yaw_pitch: interpret absolute yaw and pitch values relative to the agent body and world coordinates
interpret_relative_yaw: interpret relative yaw directions with respect to the agent body orientation
interpret_relative_pitch: interpret relative pitch directions using up or down keywords and degree values
